plans.note: Primary text in Section 21 (Limitation of Liability); check mutuality of the cap, cap quantum tied to Fees, and the 'Excluded Claims' definition in Section 1 for carve-out scope (IP indemnity, confidentiality, data breach, wilful misconduct).
Section 20 should carry Vendor IP and misconduct indemnities; confirm any Customer indemnity is narrow, and cross-check Section 21 carve-outs and Section 15 data/privacy claims.
No dedicated restrictive-covenant section; scan Customer Responsibilities and General for any covenant limiting our businesses, products or competing purchases before concluding absent.
Check the scope/structure language in Sections 2 and 4 (Order Forms and Affiliate Orders) for sole-source or exclusive-supplier wording; likely absent but often buried in scope clauses.
Pricing terms in Section 7 and order mechanics in Section 4 are where an MFN would sit; flag only if it runs against us (obliging us to give Vendor best terms).

Non-solicits typically appear in General or alongside Confidentiality/personnel provisions; verify it binds us for no more than 12 months with a general-advertising and inbound-applicant carve-out, and is mutual.

Section 9 governs termination rights; confirm we have convenience termination on reasonable notice without penalty or early-termination fee, and that Vendor lacks a mid-term convenience right (check Sections 8 and 10 for fee consequences).
Section 8 (Term and Renewal) for auto-renewal mechanics and non-renewal notice window (target 30 days, not 90+); Section 7 for renewal price uplift caps.

Section 28 — confirm governing law is NY, DE, CA or England and Wales and that disputes go to courts of that jurisdiction rather than offshore arbitration; note counterparty is a Ltd., so a non-approved law/seat is plausible.

Section 24 (Assignment and Change of Control) — secure our right to assign to Affiliates and successors without consent, and delete any Vendor termination right triggered by our change of control; check General for a residual assignment clause.

Section 14 for Deliverable ownership and any feedback/derivative assignment to Vendor; Section 15 for Customer Data ownership and use rights; Section 13 to ensure the licence-back to Vendor is limited to providing the Services.

Section 13 (Access Rights and Licence) — extend scope to our Affiliates and contractors acting for our benefit, remove 'revocable at will' or unilateral suspension language; cross-check Affiliate order rights in Section 4.

Section 22 governs audits of our usage — limit to once per 12 months, 10+ business days' notice, business hours, remote/off-site where feasible, Vendor's cost absent material underpayment; Section 23 for records retention obligations.

Check Section 7 for late-payment penalties or liquidated sums payable by us and Section 3 for the service-credit regime (credits to us are acceptable); ensure Section 21 does not preserve penalty amounts against us.

Section 19 for the performance warranty period and remedy (re-perform, then refund); Section 6 acceptance and Section 3 performance standards inform the warranty trigger and any disclaimer of implied warranties.

Section 18 exists — verify limits and lines (commercial general liability, professional/E&O, cyber, workers' comp), additional-insured/certificate rights, and that coverage is not capped by the liability clause; Section 17 for the security nexus.

Look for committed spend, take-or-pay or true-up language in Section 7 and Order Form mechanics in Section 4; if present, pair with our convenience termination right in Section 9 so any commitment has an exit.

Section 11 (Transition Assistance and Data Return) — confirm a defined assistance period at agreed rates, data return in a usable format, deletion certification, and that these survive per Section 10; cross-check Section 15 data rights.
